lines.zh: 每走一步，石头就红一圈。
lines.en: Each step reddens the stone around me.

lines.zh: 我拖着熔炉一样的腿走。
lines.en: I walk on legs like a furnace.

lines.zh: 我在炉口添最后一块煤。
lines.en: I add one last coal to the furnace mouth.
The fire is too strong. I must tamp it.
I sit down on a heap of ore.
I read the color of the furnace fire.
You carry the smell of raw meat.
Do your boots not fear the heat?
You look like a buyer for my eggs.
Not too close. Sparks will fly.
Do you want to trade for a lava giant?
I watch your hands. They are empty.

lines.zh: 你身后那片影子很凉快。
lines.en: That shadow behind you looks cool.
You smell of iron and sweat.
To trade, come closer to the furnace.
Was that armor forged, or smelted?
One look at you and my fire flares.

lines.zh: 石臂裂了，岩浆顺着缝流下来。
lines.en: My stone arm cracks; lava runs down the seam.

lines.zh: 火熄了一半，我得添燃料。
lines.en: Half my fire is out; I need fuel.
Even a lava giant's leg can break.

lines.zh: 护甲熔了一半，火还在烧。
lines.en: Half my armor has melted, and the fire still burns.

lines.zh: 给我几块矿石，比药还管用。
lines.en: A few chunks of ore work better on me than medicine.

lines.zh: 来吧，尝尝这熔岩的味道！
你手里的煤，正合我胃口。
lines.en: The coal in your hand suits my appetite.

lines.zh: 熔岩巨人听我的，你也听我的。
lines.en: The lava golem obeys me; so will you.

lines.zh: 熔炉的身子，烫到你了吧。
lines.en: My furnace body — did it scald you?
The lava giant needs to pass.
Careful. My hide is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 炉口的火，一直给你留着。
lines.en: The furnace mouth stays lit for you.

lines.zh: 蛋里孵出的巨人，缺个伴。
lines.en: The giant hatched from that egg needs a mate.

lines.zh: 熔炉边少了另一个影子。
lines.en: Another shadow is missing by the furnace.

lines.zh: 两个熔岩巨人，火会更旺。
lines.en: Two lava giants would burn brighter.

lines.zh: 你孵的那颗蛋，认我做伴了。
lines.en: The egg you hatched has taken me as its mate.
Tame me, and you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 我的熔炉里有你想要的。
lines.en: I have what you want in my forge.

lines.zh: 别看我的外貌，我很温柔。
lines.en: Don't judge me by my appearance.

lines.zh: 用我来抵御敌人的攻击吧。
lines.en: Use me to defend against attackers.

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了保护村落。
lines.en: My existence is to protect the village.
I can only survive in lava.

lines.zh: 我的攻击只能针对敌人。
lines.en: My attacks are only for enemies.

lines.zh: 给我一些食物，我就可以战斗。
lines.en: Feed me and I can fight.

lines.zh: 我是你的保护者，紧随我。

lines.en: Follow me, I'll lead the way.

lines.zh: 我们联手，敌人就难以对付。
lines.en: Together we stand strong against the enemy.

lines.zh: 我将引导你到达安全之地。
集中火力，我们胜利在望。
我的攻击即将来临，小心。
lines.en: My attack is coming, be careful.

lines.zh: 瞄准关键部位，一击必杀。
lines.en: Target the vital spots, one hit will kill.

lines.zh: 集中攻击，我们将击溃他们。
lines.en: Focus the attack, we'll defeat them.
Target the enemy, prepare to attack.
My attack will decide the outcome.

lines.zh: 我一步踩下去，地面就发烫。
lines.en: Each step I take leaves the ground hot.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，这岩浆中的炙热！
lines.en: Hisss, the heat from the lava!

lines.zh: 熔岩之火灼烧着我的身体！
用铁来淬炼，熔炉是我的家！
lines.en: Iron for the forge, my home is the smelter!

lines.zh: 这熔岩巨人需要你来驯服！
lines.en: You must tame this lava giant!

lines.zh: 熔岩中的力量让我更强！
铁块在我手中变得炽热！
熔炉中的火焰如此炽烈！
lines.en: Flames in the furnace are fierce!
Forge armor for me with ores!

lines.zh: 熔岩之火，我永恒的伙伴！
熔炉中锻造，是我唯一的使命！
lines.en: Forging in the furnace, my only purpose!
Lava giant, child of the smelter!
Heat from the furnace feeds me!
Strength from the lava flows into me!

lines.zh: 我肚子里的熔岩都晃了。
lines.en: The lava in my belly sloshed.
Water is putting out my fire. So cold...

lines.zh: 岩浆壳被炸开一道口子。
lines.en: A gap is blasted open in my magma shell.
The furnace is hungry, and so am I...

lines.zh: 雷劈进我的火里，炸了满身石屑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my fire and sprays me with stone chips.
